title: Amazingly Aromatic Venezuelan Cheese Curds Empanadas
description: Briny and springy empanadas filled with miso marinated cheese curds, perfect for a date night, and made with FODMAP friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add the crumbled cheese curds to the marinade and mix until well coated.
Let the cheese curds marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the marinated cheese curds in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg mixed with water.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with the remaining egg wash.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
